notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Source is Shell plc's 2025 Form 20-F as filed with the SEC (accession 0001628280-26-017024), which includes the Annual Report; Shell reports in US dollars. SAWAN: CEO; 266,533 ordinary shares at January 1, 2025 and 378,519 at December 31, 2025. The 20-F gives no percentage; Directors and Senior Management together held less than 1% of Company shares at December 31, 2025, so pctEconomic is null. His interest rose by a further 180,577 shares by March 4, 2026, after delivery of 2025 bonus shares and vesting of the 2023 share award. The 550,431 unvested performance-conditioned awards are not counted. BLACKROCK: 457,454,997 shares from a Schedule 13G/A filed April 23, 2025 (the 20-F gives no as-of date, so asOf is the filing date), divided by the ordinary shares outstanding at March 4, 2026; the 20-F lists only investors with 5% or more. DIVIDENDS exclude $147m paid to non-controlling interests. BUYBACKS exclude $1,300m of 'Shares held in trust: net purchases and dividends received' (employee share plan trusts). STOCK COMP is the equity-settled share-based compensation expense in Note 28 ($774m, also in the employee costs note). After the fiscal year, Shell acquired ARC Resources Ltd. in the third quarter of 2026, partly for newly issued shares (228,003,843 shares issued in 2026, per the Q3 2026 interim report).
